readme:
# BallPhysics - Aerodynamic ball physics for Roblox

A physically-inspired ball physics library for Roblox. Applies Magnus effect, knuckleball drift, angular damping, and anti-gravity forces to tagged ball parts. Forces are modelled after real aerodynamic phenomena but tuned for gameplay feel.

Simulation runs on whichever machine owns the ball's network physics - the library handles ownership handoff between server and clients automatically.

This started as a private physics system I built for my own games. Exploiters kept decompiling it, so when I decided to rewrite it I took it as a chance to do it properly and put it out publicly - so anyone can use it.

---

## Showcase

### 🎥 Magnus curve

A spinning ball curving sideways in flight.

![Magnus Curve](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/77bb2f07-9da9-490c-a8c0-8d7a57a20246)

### 🎥 Knuckleball drift

A near-zero-spin ball drifting unpredictably.

![Knuckle](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9fcf0f6e-79f8-42d6-b173-3b1074723cb7)

### 🎥 Topspin and backspin

One ball dips early, the other floats.

![Top Spin](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f2a21547-7e25-47c2-a943-6820afdd8ae2)
![Back Spin](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f254839b-59ed-4316-a03d-dfa90f5d4a20)

---

## Installation

Choose whichever method suits your workflow:

### Option A - Release file

Download the latest `.rbxm` from the [Releases page](../../releases) and insert it into your place via Studio. Place `BallPhysics` into `ReplicatedStorage`, then follow the setup steps in [Quick start](#quick-start).

### Option B - Wally _(recommended for source control)_

Add BallPhysics to your `wally.toml`:

```toml
[dependencies]
BallPhysics = "thaalish/ball-physics@1.0.0"
```

Then run:

```
wally install
rojo serve default.project.json
```

Rojo places everything under `ReplicatedStorage`:

| Roblox name   | Filesystem | Purpose                                   |
| ------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `BallPhysics` | `src/`     | Module library                            |
| `Setup`       | `dev/`     | Auto-setup and debug scripts _(dev only)_ |
| `Tests`       | `test/`    | Unit test specs _(dev only)_              |

> `Setup` and `Tests` are only included in the dev project (`default.project.json`) - not in release builds. See [Running tests](#running-tests) and [Debug tools](#debug-tools) for more.

## Quick start

1. Install and sync (above)
2. Tag any `BasePart` (Shape = Ball) with the CollectionService tag defined in `Config.ballTag` (default: `"PhysicsBall"`)

--[=[
	AlarmClock by boatbomber
	3/5/2021 | Distributed under MIT License
--]=]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AlarmClock = {
	Watchlist = table.create(10),
	DestroyConnections = table.create(10),
	SteppedConnection = nil,
}

local SLEEPING = Vector3.zero
local PUSH = Vector3.new(0, -0.08, 0)
local PRECISION = 0.001

local function SteppedFunction()
	-- Iterate through forbidden parts and wake any that are attempting to sleep
	for _, Part in ipairs(AlarmClock.Watchlist) do
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			if Part:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
				local networkOwner = Part:GetNetworkOwner()
				if networkOwner then
					continue
				end
			else
				continue
			end
		end

		if (Part.AssemblyLinearVelocity - SLEEPING).Magnitude <= PRECISION then
			Part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = PUSH
		end
	end
end

function AlarmClock:ForbidSleep(Part)
	-- Validate
	if (typeof(Part) ~= "Instance") or (not Part:IsA("BasePart")) then
		warn("Attempt to ForbidSleep on invalid part")
		return
	end
	if table.find(self.Watchlist, Part) then
		warn("Attempt to forbid a part that's already forbidden")
		return
	end

	-- Add part to watchlist
	self.Watchlist[#self.Watchlist + 1] = Part

	-- Start our watcher if we haven't yet
	if not self.SteppedConnection then
		self.SteppedConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(SteppedFunction)
	end

	-- Create a destroy watcher if one doesn't exist
	if not self.DestroyConnections[Part] then
		self.DestroyConnections[Part] = Part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			if not Part:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				self:AllowSleep(Part)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function AlarmClock:AllowSleep(Part)
	-- Validate
	if (typeof(Part) ~= "Instance") or (not Part:IsA("BasePart")) then
		warn("Attempt to AllowSleep on invalid part")
		return
	end

	-- Find the part within our watchlist
	local PartIndex = table.find(self.Watchlist, Part)
	if not PartIndex then
		return
	end

	-- Remove the part without shifting the array via unordered removal
	if PartIndex == #self.Watchlist then
		self.Watchlist[PartIndex] = nil
	else
		self.Watchlist[PartIndex] = self.Watchlist[#self.Watchlist]
		self.Watchlist[#self.Watchlist] = nil
	end

	-- Clear our part destroy connection
	if self.DestroyConnections[Part] then
		self.DestroyConnections[Part]:Disconnect()
		self.DestroyConnections[Part] = nil
	end

	-- Stop our watcher if we no longer need it
	if #self.Watchlist < 1 and self.SteppedConnection then
		self.SteppedConnection:Disconnect()
		self.SteppedConnection = nil
	end
end

function AlarmClock:ForbidSleepForDuration(Part, Duration)
	-- Validate
	if (typeof(Part) ~= "Instance") or (not Part:IsA("BasePart")) then
		warn("Attempt to ForbidSleepForDuration on invalid part")
		return
	end

	Duration = type(Duration) == "number" and Duration or 1

	coroutine.wrap(function()
		local t = os.clock()

		self:ForbidSleep(Part)

		-- Accurate wait the specified duration before allowing sleep
		while true do
			if os.clock() - t >= Duration then
				break
			end
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end

		self:AllowSleep(Part)
	end)()
end

function AlarmClock:AllowAllSleep()
	-- Free all watched parts
	table.clear(self.Watchlist)

	-- Stop our watcher as we no longer need it
	if self.SteppedConnection then
		self.SteppedConnection:Disconnect()
		self.SteppedConnection = nil
	end

	-- Clear destroy connections
	for _, Connect in pairs(self.DestroyConnections) do
		Connect:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self.DestroyConnections)
end

return AlarmClock

--!strict
--[[
	This is the main configuration file for BallPhysics. Adjust the values below
	to tune how each physics effect feels in your game - no other files need to
	be touched for standard configuration.
--]]

export type Config = {
	-- CollectionService tag that identifies balls.
	ballTag: string,

	-- Name of the RemoteEvent created under ReplicatedStorage for client-server replication.
	replicationChannel: string,

	angularDamping: {
		enabled: boolean,
		-- How aggressively spin decays while the ball is on the ground.
		-- Higher values stop the ball spinning faster.
		groundRate: number,
		-- How aggressively spin decays while the ball is airborne.
		-- Keep this below groundRate so balls retain spin longer in the air.
		airRate: number,
	},

	magnus: {
		enabled: boolean,
		-- Density used in the Magnus formula when the ball has no CustomPhysicalProperties.
		-- Higher values produce a stronger curve.
		defaultDensity: number,
		-- Global multiplier applied to the Magnus force after the formula.
		-- 1 = physically accurate, >1 exaggerates the curve, <1 reduces it.
		strength: number,
	},

	knuckleball: {
		enabled: boolean,
		-- Peak lateral acceleration (stud/s^2) applied perpendicular to the travel direction.
		-- Multiplied by mass internally, so the effect feels the same regardless of ball weight.
		strength: number,
		-- Ball speed (stud/s) at which the knuckleball effect reaches full intensity.
		-- The effect ramps from zero at SPEED_THRESHOLD up to full intensity at this speed.
		-- Above this speed the intensity stays at maximum - fast balls still knuckleball.
		targetSpeed: number,
		-- Primary oscillation frequency in rad/s.
		-- 7 rad/s ~ 1.1 Hz, so the drift direction reverses roughly once per second.
		-- A second harmonic at 1.618x this frequency adds variation without pure repetition.
		oscillationFrequency: number,
	},

	antiGravity: {
		enabled: boolean,
		-- Fraction of gravity to cancel (0 = no effect, 1 = full weightlessness).
		fraction: number,
	},

	debug: {
		enabled: boolean,
		-- How often the debug overlay labels refresh, in seconds.
		updateInterval: number,
		-- Ball speed (stud/s) at which the SelectionBox colour gradient reaches full red.
		speedColorCeiling: number,
	},
}

local config: Config = {
	ballTag = "PhysicsBall",
	replicationChannel = "BallPhysicsReplication",

	angularDamping = {
		enabled = true,
		groundRate = 1,
		airRate = 0.65,
	},

	magnus = {
		enabled = true,
		defaultDensity = 0.7,
		strength = 1,
	},

	knuckleball = {
		enabled = true,
		strength = 40,
		targetSpeed = 110,
		oscillationFrequency = 7,
	},

	antiGravity = {
		enabled = true,
		fraction = 0.625,
	},

	debug = {
		enabled = false,
		updateInterval = 0.05,
		speedColorCeiling = 150,
	},
}

return config

--!strict
--[[
	Type definitions for writing custom effects.
	Import this module for full type safety:

		local Types = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.BallPhysics.Types)
		type Effect = Types.Effect
--]]

-- Describes a physics modifier applied to a ball each simulation frame.
-- Pass a table with these fields to BallPhysics.registerEffect().
export type Effect = {
	-- The Instance property to write each frame (e.g. "Force", "AssemblyAngularVelocity").
	property: string,

	-- Name of a child Instance on the ball to target.
	-- If nil, the ball BasePart itself is the target.
	instance: string?,

	-- Display name used by setEffectEnabled / isEffectEnabled.
	-- Only needed when `instance` is nil; otherwise `instance` doubles as the key.
	name: string?,

	-- Called once by Simulator.new() to create the child Instance when it doesn't exist.
	-- Return the new Instance - name and parent are set automatically after this returns.
	setup: ((ball: BasePart) -> Instance)?,

	-- Whether the effect runs each frame. Can be toggled at runtime.
	enabled: boolean,

	-- Returns the new value for `property`, called every frame.
	-- Omit for setup-only effects whose value never changes after setup (e.g. a constant VectorForce).
	compute: ((ball: BasePart, deltaTime: number) -> any)?,

	-- Value written to `property` when the simulator transitions into idle.
	-- Only needed for effects whose idle state is not the property's existing value
	-- (e.g. a VectorForce that should read Vector3.zero while the ball is inactive).
	-- If omitted, no reset is performed on idle.
	resetValue: any?,
}

return {}

--!strict
--[[
	A physically-inspired ball physics library for Roblox. Applies Magnus effect,
	knuckleball drift, angular damping, and anti-gravity forces to tagged ball parts.
	Forces are modelled after real aerodynamic phenomena but tuned for gameplay feel.

	SETUP
		The simplest way to get started is via the scripts in the Setup folder

	SERVER
		Call BallPhysics.new(ball) for each ball part you want to track.

	CLIENT
		Call BallPhysics.new() once to start the replication singleton.

	CUSTOM EFFECTS
		Register additional effects before the first .new() call:
			BallPhysics.registerEffect(myEffect)

	CONFIGURATION
		All tunable values are in Config.luau - no other files need to be edited.
--]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Effects = require(script.Effects)

-- `any` because Server and Client return different sets of functions.
local impl: any = if RunService:IsServer() then require(script.Runtime.Server) else require(script.Runtime.Client)

return {
	-- Server: pass a ball BasePart to begin simulation.
	-- Client: call once with no argument to start replication.
	new = impl.new,

	-- Whether this client owns the ball's simulation. Always nil on the server.
	isOwned = impl.isOwned,

	-- Register a custom effect. Must be called before the first .new().
	registerEffect = Effects.register,

	-- Enable or disable a named effect at runtime.
	-- Built-in names: "AntiGravity", "AngularDamping", "MagnusForce", "KnuckleBall"
	setEffectEnabled = Effects.setEffectEnabled,

	-- Returns the enabled state of a named effect, or nil if not found.
	isEffectEnabled = Effects.isEffectEnabled,
}

--!strict
--[[
	Slows the ball's spin over time, simulating air resistance and surface friction.
	Spin decays faster when the ball is on the ground than when it is airborne.
	Both rates are configurable via angularDamping in Config.

	Decay formula: newOmega' = exp(-rate * deltaTime) * omega
--]]

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Runtime.Util)

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
type Effect = Types.Effect

return {
	name = "AngularDamping",
	property = "AssemblyAngularVelocity",
	enabled = Config.angularDamping.enabled,

	compute = function(ball: BasePart, deltaTime: number): Vector3
		local omega = ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity
		local rate = if Util.isTouchingGround(ball) then Config.angularDamping.groundRate else Config.angularDamping.airRate
		return math.exp(-rate * deltaTime) * omega
	end,
} :: Effect

--!strict
--[[
	Reduces the effect of gravity on the ball, making it stay in the air longer.

	The fraction of gravity cancelled is set by antiGravity.fraction in Config.
	At 1 the ball is weightless; at 0.5 it falls at half speed.

	Requires a VectorForce child named INSTANCE_NAME on the ball.
	Simulator.new() checks for an existing child and calls setup() only if one is absent.
--]]

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Runtime.Util)

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
type Effect = Types.Effect

local INSTANCE_NAME = "AntiGravity"

return {
	property = "Force",
	instance = INSTANCE_NAME,
	enabled = Config.antiGravity.enabled,

	setup = function(ball: BasePart): Instance
		local attachment = Util.getOrCreateAttachment(ball)
		local vectorForce = Instance.new("VectorForce")
		vectorForce.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		vectorForce.Force = Vector3.new(0, ball.AssemblyMass * workspace.Gravity * Config.antiGravity.fraction, 0)
		vectorForce.Attachment0 = attachment
		return vectorForce
	end,
} :: Effect

--!strict
--[[
	Simulates the unpredictable lateral drift of a knuckleball pitch.

	The ball drifts sideways in an oscillating pattern perpendicular to its travel
	direction. The effect is strongest with little to no spin - high spin suppresses
	it, as the Magnus effect dominates.

	Each ball gets a random drift pattern so multiple balls in the air at once
	behave independently.

	Requires a VectorForce child named INSTANCE_NAME on the ball.
	Simulator.new() checks for an existing child and calls setup() only if one is absent.
--]]

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Runtime.Util)

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
type Effect = Types.Effect

local INSTANCE_NAME = "KnuckleBall"

-- Minimum horizontal speed (stud/s) below which no knuckleball force is applied.
-- The effect ramps up from zero at this speed, reaching full intensity at targetSpeed.
local SPEED_THRESHOLD = 70

-- Minimum spin magnitude used as a denominator guard.
local MIN_SPIN = 0.075

-- The spin magnitude (deg/s) at which the effect is reduced to ~37% strength.
-- Double the spin and it drops to ~14%. Lower values suppress the effect sooner.
local SPIN_SCALE = 15

local ballPhases: { [BasePart]: { number } } = {}
setmetatable(ballPhases, { __mode = "k" } :: any)

local function getPhases(ball: BasePart): { number }
	if not ballPhases[ball] then
		ballPhases[ball] = { math.random() * math.pi * 2, math.random() * math.pi * 2 }
	end
	return ballPhases[ball]
end

return {
	property = "Force",
	instance = INSTANCE_NAME,
	enabled = Config.knuckleball.enabled,
	resetValue = Vector3.zero,

	setup = function(ball: BasePart): Instance
		local attachment = Util.getOrCreateAttachment(ball)
		local vectorForce = Instance.new("VectorForce")
		vectorForce.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		vectorForce.Attachment0 = attachment
		return vectorForce
	end,

	compute = function(ball: BasePart, _: number): Vector3
		local velocity = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)

		if velocity.Magnitude < SPEED_THRESHOLD or Util.isTouchingGround(ball) then
			return Vector3.zero
		end

		local speed = velocity.Magnitude
		local spin = math.max(MIN_SPIN, ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude)

		-- Intensity suppressed exponentially by spin.
		local intensity = math.exp(-spin / SPIN_SCALE)
		-- Ramp smoothly from 0 to full intensity as speed reaches targetSpeed.
		-- Above targetSpeed the intensity stays at 1 - fast balls still knuckleball.
		local speedRamp =
			math.clamp((speed - SPEED_THRESHOLD) / (Config.knuckleball.targetSpeed - SPEED_THRESHOLD), 0, 1)

		intensity = intensity * speedRamp

		if intensity < 0.01 then
			return Vector3.zero
		end

		-- Two-harmonic oscillation with per-ball phase offsets.
		-- Golden-ratio frequency ratio (~1.618) keeps the combined wave quasi-periodic:
		-- smooth and directional per-frame, but non-repeating over longer timescales.
		local phases = getPhases(ball)
		local time = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		local primaryFrequency = Config.knuckleball.oscillationFrequency -- rad/s
		local secondaryFrequency = primaryFrequency * 1.618
		local drift = math.sin(time * primaryFrequency + phases[1]) + 0.4 * math.sin(time * secondaryFrequency + phases[2])

		-- Apply force perpendicular to the horizontal velocity direction.
		-- right = 90 deg left in the XZ plane from the ball's travel direction.
		local forward = velocity.Unit
		local right = Vector3.new(-forward.Z, 0, forward.X)

		-- Multiply by mass so `strength` behaves as a mass-independent acceleration (stud/s^2).
		return right * drift * Config.knuckleball.strength * intensity * ball.AssemblyMass
	end,
} :: Effect

--!strict
--[[
	Curves the ball in flight based on how fast and in which direction it is spinning.
	A ball spinning to the right curves right; backspin produces lift.

	Formula: F = (3/2) * density * (omega:Cross(v))

	The strength of the curve is controlled by the ball's density (from CustomPhysicalProperties,
	or defaultDensity in Config if none are set) and the Config.magnus.strength multiplier.

	Requires a VectorForce child named INSTANCE_NAME on the ball.
	Simulator.new() checks for an existing child and calls setup() only if one is absent.
--]]

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Runtime.Util)

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
type Effect = Types.Effect

local INSTANCE_NAME = "MagnusForce"

local function toRadians(v: Vector3): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(math.rad(v.X), math.rad(v.Y), math.rad(v.Z))
end

local function isNaN(v: Vector3): boolean
	return v.X ~= v.X or v.Y ~= v.Y or v.Z ~= v.Z
end

return {
	property = "Force",
	instance = INSTANCE_NAME,
	enabled = Config.magnus.enabled,
	resetValue = Vector3.zero,

	setup = function(ball: BasePart): Instance
		local attachment = Util.getOrCreateAttachment(ball)
		local vectorForce = Instance.new("VectorForce")
		vectorForce.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		vectorForce.Attachment0 = attachment
		return vectorForce
	end,

	compute = function(ball: BasePart, _: number): Vector3
		local velocity = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local omega = toRadians(ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity)
		local density = if ball.CustomPhysicalProperties
			then ball.CustomPhysicalProperties.Density
			else Config.magnus.defaultDensity

		local magnus = (3 / 2) * density * Config.magnus.strength * omega:Cross(velocity)
		return if isNaN(magnus) then Vector3.zero else magnus
	end,
} :: Effect

--!strict
--[[
	Ordered registry of active physics effects.
	AngularDamping runs first so spin is current when Magnus and KnuckleBall compute their forces.

	Custom effects can be appended via register() before any Simulator is created.
--]]

local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
type Effect = Types.Effect

local effects: { Effect } = {
	require(script.AntiGravity),
	require(script.AngularDamping),
	require(script.KnuckleBall),
	require(script.MagnusEffect),
}

-- Appends a custom effect. Call before the first BallPhysics.new().
local function register(effect: Effect)
	table.insert(effects, effect)
end

-- Enables or disables the effect matching `name`.
local function setEffectEnabled(name: string, enabled: boolean)
	for _, effect in effects do
		if effect.name == name or effect.instance == name then
			effect.enabled = enabled
			return
		end
	end
	warn("BallPhysics.setEffectEnabled: no effect found with name '" .. name .. "'")
end

-- Returns the enabled state of the matching effect, or nil if not found.
local function isEffectEnabled(name: string): boolean?
	for _, effect in effects do
		if effect.name == name or effect.instance == name then
			return effect.enabled
		end
	end
	return nil
end

return {
	effects = effects,
	register = register,
	setEffectEnabled = setEffectEnabled,
	isEffectEnabled = isEffectEnabled,
}

--!strict
--[[
	Listens for ownership events from the server and runs simulation locally
	for whichever balls this client is responsible for.

	Not part of the public API - use BallPhysics.new() from init.luau instead.
--]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Simulator = require(script.Parent.Simulator)

local BALL_ID_ATTR = "_BPId"
local STREAM_TIMEOUT = 10 -- seconds to wait for a ball to stream in

local replication = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.replicationChannel) :: RemoteEvent

-- Module-level state is safe because Client is always used as a singleton.
local _owned: { BasePart } = {}

local Client = {}
Client.__index = Client

function Client.new()
	local self = setmetatable({}, Client)
	self._simulators = {} :: { [BasePart]: typeof(Simulator.new(nil :: any)) }
	self._connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self:Enable()
	return self
end

function Client.isOwned(ball: BasePart): boolean
	return table.find(_owned, ball) ~= nil
end

-- Waits for a tagged ball with the given ID to stream in, up to STREAM_TIMEOUT seconds.
local function waitForBallById(id: number): BasePart?
	for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged(Config.ballTag) do
		if instance:GetAttribute(BALL_ID_ATTR) == id then
			return instance :: BasePart
		end
	end

	local found: BasePart? = nil
	local connection: RBXScriptConnection
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	connection = CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(Config.ballTag):Connect(function(instance: Instance)
		if instance:GetAttribute(BALL_ID_ATTR) == id then
			found = instance :: BasePart
			connection:Disconnect()
			task.spawn(thread)
		end
	end)

	task.delay(STREAM_TIMEOUT, function()
		if connection.Connected then
			connection:Disconnect()
			task.spawn(thread)
		end
	end)

	coroutine.yield()
	return found
end

function Client:handleEvent(ball: BasePart, event: string)
	if event == "Add" then
		-- Pre-create a disabled simulator so Enable is instant when ownership arrives.
		if not self._simulators[ball] then
			self._simulators[ball] = Simulator.new(ball)
		end
	elseif event == "Start" then
		table.insert(_owned, ball)
		local sim = self._simulators[ball]
		if sim then
			sim:Enable()
		else
			local newSim = Simulator.new(ball)
			newSim:Enable()
			self._simulators[ball] = newSim
		end
	elseif event == "End" then
		local index = table.find(_owned, ball)
		if index then
			table.remove(_owned, index)
		end

		local sim = self._simulators[ball]
		if sim then
			sim:Disable()
		end
	end
end

function Client:Enable()
	self:Disable()
	self._connection = replication.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(ball: BasePart, event: string, ballId: number)
		if ball then
			self:handleEvent(ball, event)
			return
		end

		-- StreamingEnabled: instance hasn't replicated yet. Wait for it by attribute.
		task.spawn(function()
			local streamed = waitForBallById(ballId)
			if streamed then
				self:handleEvent(streamed, event)
			else
				local msg = ("BallPhysics: ball ID %d did not stream within %ds - '%s' event dropped"):format(
					ballId, STREAM_TIMEOUT, event)
				if event == "Start" then
					-- "Start" means this client was assigned ownership but the ball never
					-- arrived. Simulation will not run for this ball on this client.
					warn(msg .. " (client will not simulate this ball)")
				else
					warn(msg)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
end

function Client:Disable()
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
end

function Client:Destroy()
	self:Disable()
	for _, sim in self._simulators do
		sim:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(self._simulators)
	table.clear(_owned)
end

return Client

--!strict
--[[
	Manages one ball's physics simulation on the server side.
	Watches network ownership each frame - when a client takes ownership, simulation
	is handed off to them. When they release it, the server resumes.

	Not part of the public API - use BallPhysics.new(ball) from init.luau instead.
--]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local nextBallId = 0
local BALL_ID_ATTR = "_BPId"

local Config = require(script.Parent.Parent.Config)
local Simulator = require(script.Parent.Simulator)

-- Created once when this module first loads on the server.
local replication = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
replication.Name = Config.replicationChannel
replication.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local Server = {}
Server.__index = Server

function Server.new(ball: BasePart)
	assert(typeof(ball) == "Instance" and ball:IsA("BasePart"), "Server: expected BasePart, got " .. typeof(ball))

	-- Assign a stable unique ID so clients with StreamingEnabled can identify this
	-- ball by attribute if the Instance arrives as nil in the RemoteEvent.
	nextBallId += 1
	ball:SetAttribute(BALL_ID_ATTR, nextBallId)

	local self = setmetatable({}, Server)
	self.ball = ball
	self._ballId = nextBallId
	self._owner = nil :: Player?
	self._simulator = Simulator.new(ball)
	self._heartbeat = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self._parentChanged = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self._playerAdded = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self._isAnnounced = false

	-- Notify all current clients, and any who join later.
	-- Deferred until the ball is in workspace so the Instance has replicated
	-- before clients receive the event. The ball ID is sent alongside so
	-- clients with StreamingEnabled can wait for it by attribute if the
	-- Instance arrives as nil.
	local function announceToClients()
		if self._isAnnounced then
			return
		end
		self._isAnnounced = true
		replication:FireAllClients(ball, "Add", self._ballId)
		self._playerAdded = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
			replication:FireClient(player, ball, "Add", self._ballId)
		end)
	end

	self._parentChanged = ball:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
		if not self.ball.Parent then
			self:Destroy()
		elseif self.ball:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			announceToClients()
		end
	end)

	if ball:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		announceToClients()
	end

	self:Enable()
	return self
end

function Server:_applyOwnerChange(old: Player?, new: Player?)
	if not old and new then
		-- Server -> Client: hand simulation to the owning client.
		replication:FireClient(new, self.ball, "Start", self._ballId)
		self._simulator:Disable()
	elseif old and not new then
		-- Client -> Server: reclaim simulation.
		replication:FireClient(old, self.ball, "End", self._ballId)
		self._simulator:Enable()
	else
		-- Client -> Client: transfer without a server gap.
		replication:FireClient(old :: Player, self.ball, "End", self._ballId)
		replication:FireClient(new :: Player, self.ball, "Start", self._ballId)
	end
end

function Server:Enable()
	self:Disable()
	self._simulator:Enable()

	self._heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		-- GetNetworkOwner returns nil when the server controls the part.
		local actual: Player? = if self.ball:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then self.ball:GetNetworkOwner() else nil

		if actual ~= self._owner then
			local prev = self._owner
			self._owner = actual
			self:_applyOwnerChange(prev, actual)
		end
	end)
end

function Server:Disable()
	if self._heartbeat then
		self._heartbeat:Disconnect()
		self._heartbeat = nil
	end
end

function Server:Destroy()
	self:Disable()

	if self._parentChanged then
		self._parentChanged:Disconnect()
		self._parentChanged = nil
	end

	if self._playerAdded then
		self._playerAdded:Disconnect()
		self._playerAdded = nil
	end

	self._simulator:Destroy()
	self.ball = nil :: any
end

return Server

--!strict
--[[
	Runs all registered physics effects on a ball every frame.
	Managed by Server and Client - does not start automatically on construction.

	Not part of the public API - use BallPhysics.new() from init.luau instead.
--]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local AlarmClock = require(script.Parent.Parent.AlarmClock)

local Effects = require(script.Parent.Parent.Effects)

-- Balls below both thresholds are considered idle and skip the effects loop.
local IDLE_LINEAR_THRESHOLD = 0.5  -- stud/s
local IDLE_ANGULAR_THRESHOLD = 0.1 -- rad/s

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
type Effect = Types.Effect

local Simulator = {}
Simulator.__index = Simulator

export type SimulatorInstance = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
	ball: BasePart,
	_stepped: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_isIdle: boolean,
}, Simulator))

function Simulator.new(ball: BasePart): SimulatorInstance
	assert(ball.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball, "Simulator: part must be a ball")

	local self = setmetatable({}, Simulator)
	self.ball = ball
	self._stepped = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self._isIdle = false

	for _, effect: Effect in Effects.effects do
		if effect.enabled and effect.instance and effect.setup then
			if not ball:FindFirstChild(effect.instance) then
				local inst = effect.setup(ball)
				inst.Name = effect.instance
				inst.Parent = ball
			end
		end
	end

	return self
end

function Simulator:Enable()
	self:Disable()
	self._isIdle = false
	AlarmClock:ForbidSleep(self.ball)

	-- Pre-build profiler labels once so there's no string work inside the Stepped callback.
	local effects = Effects.effects
	local profileLabels: { string } = table.create(#effects)
	for i, effect: Effect in effects do
		profileLabels[i] = "BallPhysics/" .. (effect.name or effect.instance or effect.property)
	end

	self._stepped = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, deltaTime: number)
		debug.profilebegin("BallPhysics/Stepped")
		local ball: BasePart = self.ball
		if not ball or not ball:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			self:Disable()
			debug.profileend()
			return
		end

		-- Skip effects when the ball is anchored/welded or both velocities are below their thresholds.
		if ball:IsGrounded()
			or (ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < IDLE_LINEAR_THRESHOLD
				and ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude < IDLE_ANGULAR_THRESHOLD)
		then
			-- On the first idle frame, apply each effect's resetValue so residual
			-- forces don't keep pushing the ball while inactive.
			if not self._isIdle then
				self._isIdle = true
				for _, effect: Effect in effects do
					if not effect.enabled or effect.resetValue == nil then
						continue
					end
					local target: Instance = ball
					if effect.instance then
						local child = ball:FindFirstChild(effect.instance)
						if not child then
							continue
						end
						target = child
					end
					(target :: any)[effect.property] = effect.resetValue
				end
			end
			debug.profileend()
			return
		end
		self._isIdle = false

		for i, effect: Effect in effects do
			if not effect.enabled then
				continue
			end

			local target: Instance = ball
			if effect.instance then
				local child: Instance? = ball:FindFirstChild(effect.instance)
				if not child and effect.setup then
					-- Effect was enabled after the ball was created; set up its instance now.
					local newInstance = effect.setup(ball)
					newInstance.Name = effect.instance
					newInstance.Parent = ball
					child = newInstance
				end
				if child then
					target = child
				else
					warn("Simulator: " .. effect.instance .. " not found on " .. tostring(ball))
					continue
				end
			end

			-- Setup-only effects have no compute function.
			if not effect.compute then
				continue
			end

			local current = (target :: any)[effect.property]
			debug.profilebegin(profileLabels[i])
			local new = effect.compute(ball, deltaTime)
			debug.profileend()

			-- Skip assignment when the value hasn't meaningfully changed
			-- to avoid unnecessary property replication.
			-- Always allow Vector3.zero through so effects can snap values to a true zero.
			if typeof(current) == "Vector3" and typeof(new) == "Vector3" then
				if (new :: Vector3) ~= Vector3.zero and (current :: Vector3):FuzzyEq(new :: Vector3) then
					continue
				end
			end

			(target :: any)[effect.property] = new
		end
		debug.profileend()
	end)
end

function Simulator:Disable()
	if self._stepped then
		self._stepped:Disconnect()
		self._stepped = nil
	end

	AlarmClock:AllowSleep(self.ball)
end

function Simulator:Destroy()
	self:Disable()
	self.ball = nil :: any
end

return Simulator

--!strict
--[[
	Shared helpers used across the Runtime modules.

	Not part of the public API - use BallPhysics from init.luau instead.
--]]

-- Small buffer below the ball bottom for ground detection raycasts.
local RAYCAST_BUFFER = 0.01

local RAYCAST_PARAMS = RaycastParams.new()
RAYCAST_PARAMS.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

-- Returns true when `part` has ground directly beneath it.
local function isTouchingGround(part: BasePart): boolean
	RAYCAST_PARAMS.FilterDescendantsInstances = { part }
	return workspace:Raycast(part.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(part.Size.Y / 2 + RAYCAST_BUFFER), 0), RAYCAST_PARAMS)
		~= nil
end

-- Finds or creates the PhysicsRoot Attachment at the centre of `ball`.
local function getOrCreateAttachment(ball: BasePart): Attachment
	for _, child in ball:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") and child.Name == "PhysicsRoot" then
			return child :: Attachment
		end
	end
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Name = "PhysicsRoot"
	attachment.Parent = ball
	return attachment
end

return {
	isTouchingGround = isTouchingGround,
	getOrCreateAttachment = getOrCreateAttachment,
}
